title: Princess Kate’s Cancer Documentary ‘Heal’: 3 Takeaways
summary: ‘Heal,’ a 30-minute authorized documentary released this week, offers glimpses into Catherine’s recovery since her 2024 cancer diagnosis and treatment.
caption: Catherine, Princess of Wales, touring a hospital wing in Bordon, England, in November.

title: A Journalist Fights for Free Speech in Egypt, and to Stay Out of Jail
summary: The fate of Lina Attalah and her news outlet, Mada Masr, in two court cases is seen as a test of whether the country’s independent press can survive.
caption: Lina Attalah, editor-in-chief of the news outlet Mada Masr, in Cairo this month. The outlet’s fate feels like “a real and imminent danger,” another publication’s editor said.

title: FIFA May Scrap the Peace Prize It Gave to Trump
summary: Gianni Infantino, the global soccer body’s leader, has stirred concern over his ties to President Trump. Now FIFA is rethinking the award he gave Mr. Trump last year.
caption: President Trump receiving FIFA’s peace prize in Washington last year. Over the past year, the prize has become one symbol of Mr. Infantino’s rocky tenure at the top of global soccer.

title: Far-Right Vigilantes Have Inflamed France’s Unrest, Officials Say
summary: Through weeks of antigovernment unrest, hard-right activists have fought with left-wing counterparts in at least 10 towns, according to national and regional leaders.
caption: Riot police officers in Bordeaux this month. Officials say the unrest across France has been spurred by extreme-right activists, as well as by the far left.

title: Abroad, Spain’s Leader Is a Left-Wing Hero. Will He Lose Power at Home?
summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, a staunch critic of President Trump, faces an uphill task to overcome a right-wing challenge in the national election on Sunday.
caption: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain this month at a rally near Madrid. He has taken to waving the Spanish flag, long a symbol of conservatives, at his campaign events.
